chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. It builds the chunk interchange (S1) and the simultaneous butterfly layer (S2), uses them for synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S3), removes the resampling permutations by the chirp and cancellation identities (S4), assembles the exact multiplication with the CRT map, twist and error budget (S5), and does the cost accounting (S6). Each link is derived with the paper's quantities. The tree thins in three places. The complex scalar network's gate coefficients are never given, though the complex interface is built on them. The complex rank-saving exponent s_c/W_c<m^sigma is asserted without eta_c. The linear-time stream primitives are used but never stated.

steps.note: The plan has gates indexed by three-element subsets of a 100-point set, the eight-row forward schedule and the three stages giving (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary wire restored, all derived. The formulas N=binom(100,3)^3 and m=h^3 are not written out: N appears only as the count of source projections and m only through (Q^100)^{(x)3}.

The plan has a common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, D_v D_u^{-1} on edges, the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and endpoint frames that fix each route so intermediate frames can make edges cheap. It reuses this for the shear frames Phi_M.

The plan has nondegenerate subspaces of (Q^100)^{(x)3} built from triple indicators under I-J/9, nested labels on every edge, and the only decrease on center 3->4, each losing P(x)F(x)Q of dimension h.
S1.1.1.4.1 says that for nested U in V, P_V-P_U has rank dim V-dim U. S1.1.1.4.2 says the N source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one although the dimension does not change.
The plan derives the sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich by telescoping at gates, with sink total Wm-N and source total N. It then has s_b=(W_b m-2N+2L_b)+N=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan has L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 make s<Wm.
The plan has P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on X_a->Y_a and 0 to P_F elsewhere, so every route applies Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every original row, scratch rows included.
The plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower-triangular E_i and a ones in Pi, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per shear, and s recursive calls in all at a node.
The plan has children of volume V/W, F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta_b>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 giving s_b/W_b<m^{1-2^{-50}}, and the geometric sum F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed with their defining content, in order and in their role in the chain: fixed bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N rank-one source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, L/N=100/539<1/2, the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The only thin points are that N and m are not given as formulas and that the complex-side exponent bound is not checked.
